appearance.direction: Modern minimal product editor; reuse Basketra catalog/store primitives.
appearance.rule: Scanning and manual editing are two entry modes into one canonical form, not separate persistence flows.

behavior.parentSelection: Allow selecting an existing canonical parent or creating a new canonical parent. Creating a variant under an existing parent must not duplicate the parent.
behavior.photoAnalysis: Use the product-photo AI path only as a draft producer. When analysis completes, switch to the same manual form and populate detected fields: parent/canonical name, variant, brand, EAN, category, package size/unit, requested quantity/unit when supported, price, retailer/store suggestion, confidence and warnings.
behavior.persistence: Nothing from AI or nearby-store search is persisted until explicit user confirmation.
behavior.lowAi: For product-photo-proposal only, keep Basketra's configured WebAPI model identity and request WebAPI's low reasoning variant with reasoning.effort='low'. Do not invent a model id named 'low'.
behavior.location: Store field first offers saved stores. Location is opt-in. If requested, rank known stores by distance and then allow explicit bounded OpenStreetMap/Overpass search. External candidates are not persisted until confirmed. Provide reuse of the existing Store creation editor when no saved store matches.
behavior.normalizedPrice: Derived server-side from exact money/quantity units; never independently recalculated in the browser.

responsive.mobile: Single reading column with grouped progressive sections. Keep camera/manual mode choice and primary CTA visible without permanent nested forms.
responsive.desktop: Use balanced columns for independent fields while preserving source order and labels.
